newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-TURKEY NEED WIN AND MIRACLE TO REACH WORLD CUP FINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TURKEY NEED WIN AND MIRACLE TO REACH WORLD CUP FINALS.

text.p: Turkey need to win Wednesday's World Cup qualifier against Wales if they are to keep alive their faint chances of a place in the finals in France next year.

And even a handsome victory is unlikely to be enough with the Dutch and Belgians seemingly running away with group seven and the Turks needing an away win in the Netherlands to have any hope of second place.
Realistically both teams go into the match with an eye on the future, although Turkey coach Mustafa Denizli described it as "extraordinarily important."
"We still have a chance, but this is our last chance," he added.

With the game being played at the notoriously unwelcoming Ali Sami Yen stadium, Wales boss Bobby Gould has looked for the experience of Dean Saunders, who left the Istanbul club two seasons ago after a stormy year in Turkish league soccer.
The Nottingham Forest man has been paired with Nathan Blake, who was at the centre of a racism row with Gould last season.
The Bolton striker said at the time he would never play under Gould again but after the manager apologised Blake is set for his World Cup appearance.
Chelsea centre forward Mark Hughes drops into midfield while Ryan Giggs will operate as a left wing back.
